rubric_items.deep_module: pass — §14 introduces no module; it makes two edits to existing owners (the discover code reset call and the discovered reset spec) plus a committed config-roots edit, so no new interface is spread across wrappers.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: pass — the section routes each behaviour through its existing owner rather than forking it: prefix scoping through query_builder.render_path_prefix_clause (one renderer for the five path claims, the two code claims and the reset), status lists through reset.CODE_RESET_* , and seeding through frontier.seed_facility_roots; no duplicate placement, resolution or reader is introduced.

rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — §14 searches and names the mechanisms it extends: render_path_prefix_clause (imas_codex/graph/query_builder.py:268), reset_to_status/CODE_RESET_SPECS (imas_codex/discovery/base/reset.py:59,349), seed_facility_roots (imas_codex/discovery/paths/frontier.py:426) and get_facility's public-only read (imas_codex/discovery/base/facility.py:113), mirroring the existing scoped-reset call site at imas_codex/cli/discover/paths.py:243-256.
